rules.title: Disable the per-user advertising identifier
rules.description: Turns off the Windows advertising ID for the current user.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous registry value.

rules.title: Disable tailored experiences
rules.description: Prevents diagnostic data from being used for personalized tips and advertisements.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous registry value.

rules.title: Disable promoted content suggestions
rules.description: Disables common Content Delivery Manager suggestion surfaces without removing Windows components.
rules.recovery: Restore each prior Content Delivery Manager value.

rules.title: Disable Activity History publishing
rules.description: Applies documented policy values that stop publishing and uploading user activities.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous machine policy values.

rules.title: Show known file extensions
rules.description: Makes file extensions visible in File Explorer.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Explorer setting.

rules.title: Show hidden files
rules.description: Shows hidden files while leaving protected operating-system files hidden.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Explorer setting.

rules.title: Open File Explorer to This PC
rules.description: Changes the default File Explorer landing page to This PC.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Explorer setting.

rules.title: Use compact File Explorer spacing
rules.description: Enables compact spacing where supported.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Explorer setting.

rules.title: Reduce menu show delay
rules.description: Uses a conservative 200 ms menu delay rather than an extreme zero-delay tweak.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior desktop menu delay.

rules.title: Use balanced visual effects
rules.description: Lets Windows choose visual effects instead of applying destructive blanket performance settings.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous visual-effects selection.

rules.title: Enable Windows Game Mode
rules.description: Enables the supported per-user Game Mode preference.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Game Mode value.

rules.title: Disable background game capture
rules.description: Disables background Game DVR capture for users who do not use it.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous capture setting.

rules.title: Enable Win32 long paths
rules.description: Enables long-path-aware applications to exceed MAX_PATH.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior machine policy value.

rules.title: Enable Developer Mode
rules.description: Allows development and sideloading features. Apply only on trusted development systems.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous AppModelUnlock policy value.

rules.title: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux
rules.description: Enables the WSL optional feature without installing a distribution.
rules.recovery: Disable the optional feature; installed distributions are not deleted.

rules.title: Enable Virtual Machine Platform
rules.description: Enables the virtualization platform commonly required by WSL 2.
rules.recovery: Disable the optional feature.

rules.title: Disable SMB 1.0/CIFS
rules.description: Disables the obsolete SMB1 protocol feature where present.
rules.recovery: Re-enable the feature only if a legacy dependency requires it.

rules.title: Disable legacy Windows PowerShell 2.0
rules.description: Disables the legacy PowerShell v2 feature when present.
rules.recovery: Re-enable the optional feature if a verified legacy dependency requires it.

rules.title: Enable Defender potentially unwanted app protection
rules.description: Enables Defender PUA protection through the supported preference cmdlet.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous PUAProtection preference.

rules.title: Avoid automatic restart while a user is logged on
rules.description: Applies the documented Windows Update policy for scheduled installations.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous Windows Update policy value.

rules.title: Disable Fast Startup
rules.description: Uses a full shutdown path, useful for dual boot and certain driver or firmware diagnostics.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior HiberbootEnabled value.

rules.title: Activate the Balanced power scheme
rules.description: Restores the built-in Balanced power scheme as a safe default.
rules.recovery: Select a different power plan in Windows Settings.

rules.title: Disable Windows feedback prompts
rules.description: Stops periodic feedback prompts for the current user.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous SIUF value.

rules.title: Show full path in File Explorer title
rules.description: Displays the complete current path in the Explorer title bar.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous CabinetState value.

rules.title: Disable cross-device clipboard sync
rules.description: Keeps clipboard data local while preserving the local clipboard.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior machine policy value.

rules.title: Enable Windows Firewall on all profiles
rules.description: Ensures Domain, Private, and Public firewall profiles are enabled without replacing existing rules.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior common firewall profile state.

rules.title: Disable the built-in Guest account
rules.description: Disables the local Guest account while preserving the account and its audit history.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Guest account enabled state.

rules.title: Disable Remote Registry startup
rules.description: Prevents the Remote Registry service from starting until explicitly restored.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous RemoteRegistry startup mode.

rules.title: Enable PowerShell script block logging
rules.description: Enables machine policy logging of PowerShell script blocks for investigation and audit.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior policy value.

rules.title: Enable PowerShell module logging
rules.description: Enables module logging for all modules through machine policy.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior module logging policy values.

rules.title: Enable PowerShell transcription
rules.description: Enables invocation-header transcription through machine policy; Windows selects the default transcript location.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior transcription policy values.

rules.title: Enable LSA protected process
rules.description: Requests protected-process-light operation for LSASS on supported systems.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior RunAsPPL value; restart is required.

rules.title: Disable WDigest plaintext credential caching
rules.description: Prevents WDigest from retaining reusable plaintext credentials in LSASS.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior WDigest value.

rules.title: Use UAC Admin Approval on secure desktop
rules.description: Enables UAC, prompts administrators for consent, and uses the secure desktop.
rules.recovery: Restore all prior UAC policy values.

rules.title: Disable AutoPlay and AutoRun
rules.description: Disables AutoPlay and AutoRun policy across drive types to reduce removable-media execution risk.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Explorer policy values.

rules.title: Disable LLMNR name resolution
rules.description: Disables multicast name resolution through DNS Client policy to reduce spoofing exposure.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior DNS Client policy value.

rules.title: Require SMB signing
rules.description: Requires security signatures for both SMB client and server communication.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior SMB signing values.

rules.title: Enable virtualization-based security policy
rules.description: Enables VBS policy using platform security features when available.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Device Guard policy values.

rules.title: Enable Credential Guard without UEFI lock
rules.description: Enables Credential Guard in a reversible policy mode where supported.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Credential Guard value.

rules.title: Enable memory integrity policy
rules.description: Enables Hypervisor-protected Code Integrity through the documented Device Guard scenario key.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior HVCI value.

rules.title: Enable advanced Defender cloud protection
rules.description: Joins Microsoft Advanced Protection Service for cloud-delivered protection.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior MAPSReporting preference.

rules.title: Use safe automatic sample submission
rules.description: Allows safe samples to be submitted automatically while continuing to prompt for other samples.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior sample-submission preference.

rules.title: Enable Defender block-at-first-seen
rules.description: Ensures the block-at-first-seen protection path is not disabled.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior preference.

rules.title: Audit Defender Network Protection
rules.description: Places Network Protection in audit mode so compatibility evidence can be collected before enforcement.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Network Protection mode.

rules.title: Audit Controlled Folder Access
rules.description: Places Controlled Folder Access in audit mode to collect compatibility evidence without blocking applications.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Controlled Folder Access mode.

rules.title: Use high cloud blocking level
rules.description: Uses Defender high cloud blocking level without selecting zero-tolerance modes.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior cloud block level.

rules.title: Check Defender signatures every four hours
rules.description: Sets a bounded signature update interval for systems that remain online.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior signature update interval.

rules.title: Enable Defender archive scanning
rules.description: Ensures archive scanning is not disabled.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior archive scanning preference.

rules.title: Disable solicited Remote Assistance
rules.description: Disables Remote Assistance invitations by machine policy without changing Remote Desktop.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Remote Assistance value.

rules.title: Do not store LAN Manager password hashes
rules.description: Prevents storage of legacy LAN Manager password hashes for future password changes.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior NoLMHash value.

rules.title: Restrict anonymous SAM enumeration
rules.description: Prevents anonymous users from enumerating local accounts.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior RestrictAnonymousSAM value.

rules.title: Use system-default TLS and strong crypto for .NET Framework
rules.description: Enables strong cryptography and system-default TLS for 32-bit and 64-bit .NET Framework 4 applications.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior .NET Framework values.

rules.title: Disable TLS 1.0 client and server protocols
rules.description: Disables TLS 1.0 in Schannel. Apply only after legacy dependency assessment.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Schannel TLS 1.0 values.

rules.title: Disable TLS 1.1 client and server protocols
rules.description: Disables TLS 1.1 in Schannel. Apply only after legacy dependency assessment.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Schannel TLS 1.1 values.

rules.title: Enable TLS 1.2 client and server protocols
rules.description: Explicitly enables TLS 1.2 in Schannel.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior Schannel TLS 1.2 values.

rules.title: Set required diagnostic data policy
rules.description: Uses the broadly supported required diagnostic data level rather than unsupported blanket telemetry breakage.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior diagnostic data policy.

rules.title: Disable Microsoft consumer experiences
rules.description: Disables consumer feature promotion through machine policy without removing Store infrastructure.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior CloudContent policy.

rules.title: Set diagnostic telemetry policy to security-only
rules.description: Applies the AllowTelemetry=0 machine policy. This level is edition-dependent and can reduce diagnostic supportability.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior AllowTelemetry policy value.

rules.title: Disable Problem Steps Recorder telemetry
rules.description: Disables the Application Compatibility Problem Steps Recorder through machine policy.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior DisableUAR value.

rules.title: Disable Application Impact Telemetry
rules.description: Disables Application Impact Telemetry collection through machine policy.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior AITEnable value.

rules.title: Disable Windows CEIP participation
rules.description: Disables Windows Customer Experience Improvement Program participation through machine policy.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior CEIPEnable value.

rules.title: Notify before Windows Update download
rules.description: Sets the classic AUOptions policy to notify before download. Modern Windows behavior can vary by edition and management state.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior AUOptions value.

rules.title: Restrict Delivery Optimization to HTTP-only mode
rules.description: Sets Delivery Optimization download mode to 0, disabling peer delivery.
rules.recovery: Restore the prior DODownloadMode value.

rules.title: Use dark application and system theme
rules.description: Applies the dark-theme registry preferences for the current user.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.

rules.title: Disable Windows Spotlight suggestions
rules.description: Disables lock-screen and shell Spotlight suggestion surfaces for the current user.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.

rules.title: Hide Meet Now from the taskbar
rules.description: Hides the legacy Meet Now surface.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.

rules.title: Hide the People taskbar surface
rules.description: Disables and hides the legacy People Bar.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.

rules.title: Disable taskbar news and interests
rules.description: Disables the legacy taskbar feeds surface.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.

rules.title: Disable online tips in Settings
rules.description: Prevents the Settings application from showing online help content.
rules.recovery: Restore the previous exact registry values.
